name: PlanSelector
usage_hint: Subscribe-and-save plan cards — large radio cards (Autoship vs One-Time) with per-card price, compare-at, per-unit cost, benefit checklist, and live re-pricing from a tier selector. The dominant DTC PDP purchase pattern.
when_to_use: On PDPs offering a subscription plan alongside one-time purchase, styled as prominent selectable cards. Emits subscription:changed so a BuyBox with listenForEvents picks up the selling plan and price with no extra wiring. Set listenForTiers:true to re-price cards live from a QuantityBreaks selector (emitEvents:true). Add data-island-container to the placement div to inject custom HTML (e.g. a QuantityBreaks island) inside the first plan card body.
when_not_to_use: For a lightweight inline toggle use SubscriptionToggle. For quantity-only discounts without a subscription option use QuantityBreaks alone. Not a cart CTA — pair with BuyBox or ProceedToCart for add-to-cart.
anti_patterns: Using together with SubscriptionToggle on the same page (both emit subscription:changed — they fight)
Omitting a BuyBox/ProceedToCart CTA (PlanSelector selects, it does not add to cart)
Styling selection via inline overrides (target [data-part="plan"][data-selected="true"] in CSS instead)
Doing price math in props at runtime (pass pre-formatted strings; tiers:changed payloads carry pre-computed subscribe prices)

examples.label: Subscribe & Save vs one-time with benefits checklist
examples.source:
<lx-island name="PlanSelector">
  <script type="application/json">{"plans":[{"id":"subscribe","title":"Subscribe & Save 20%","price":"$19.95","compareAtPrice":"$24.95","note":"Free shipping · Cancel anytime","sellingPlanId":"sp-monthly","frequency":"monthly","benefits":["20% off every month","Free shipping on all orders","Pause or cancel anytime","Exclusive subscriber offers"]},{"id":"one-time","title":"One-time purchase","price":"$24.95","note":"No subscription"}],"defaultPlanId":"subscribe"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Re-priced live by a QuantityBreaks tier selector
examples.source:
<lx-island name="PlanSelector">
  <script type="application/json">{"listenForTiers":true,"plans":[{"id":"subscribe","title":"Autoship & Save","price":"$28.99","compareAtPrice":"$36.50","perUnit":"$0.67/Serving","sellingPlanId":"sp-30d","frequency":"every 30 days","benefits":["FREE Avg 2-Day Shipping Today","Cancel, Pause Or Change At Anytime"]},{"id":"one-time","title":"One-Time Purchase","price":"$36.50","perUnit":"$0.83/Serving"}]}</script>
</lx-island>
